gate_policy.broad_screens_n_ge_100: top agreement >= 0.90; median TV <= 0.05; p90 TV <= 0.15
gate_policy.classification: CONTEXTUAL_SEMANTIC_PRIOR_PASS when all original gates pass; BORDERLINE when overall top agreement >= 0.90, median TV <= 0.05, p90 TV <= 0.15, and no broad screen is severe (<0.80 top agreement, >0.10 median TV, or >0.20 p90 TV); otherwise REJECTED
gate_policy.margin: difference between the highest and second-highest raw candidate logits before primitive multiplicity correction
gate_policy.multiplicity: softmax semantic-candidate logits, divide each candidate weight by the count of candidates sharing its primitiveBits, then renormalize
gate_policy.overall: unique canonical priors: top semantic action agreement >= 0.95; median TV <= 0.03; p90 TV <= 0.10
gate_policy.top_prior_probability_error: absolute student-versus-teacher prior error at the teacher-selected top semantic candidate
